description:
Okay, so you're in a kitchen, cool, but is it usual? You better believe it is. The room seems oddly familiar, as though it were only superficially different from the other rooms in the building.

You see a fridge. If you haven't noticed it already, there seems to be something there by the wall, it's an oven. Something scurries by right in the corner of your eye. Probably nothing. You can make out a table. The table is massive. On the table you make out a cookbook and a knife. Look over there! a counter. The counter is vast. On the counter you can see a red apple. Look out! It's a- oh, never mind, it's just a stove. Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it. You make a mental note to not get your hopes up the next time you see a stove in a room.
